piece: #hero — first viewport, 393x852 CSS px, DPR 3, 4x CPU throttle
motion: The 6-frame filmstrip is useless by construction and shows nothing: all six hero-motion-*.png files are byte-identical (md5 840d9c20b179b26d3209eea8fa8a40ec, 432832 bytes each), because #hero sits at y=0 so the harness scroll target computes to max(0, 0 - 613) = 0 and no scroll ever happens, and the 900ms post-reload wait outlasts the reveal. Sampling the entrance directly from navigation commit instead: .hero-display is opacity 1 / transform none at every one of 26 samples (it never animates — correct, since SPEC 4 forbids animation delaying LCP paint). .hero-lede and .hero-actions start at opacity 0, translateY(18px) and run to opacity 1, translateY(0) over ~620ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), the actions trailing the lede by 72ms (at t=749ms: lede opacity 0.605 / translateY 7.11px, actions opacity 0.110 / translateY 16.01px). Only opacity and transform animate. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the transition collapses to 1e-05s and both sit at opacity 1 / translateY 0. So the reveal itself is exactly to spec; the filmstrip just never caught it.
biggestGap: The .hero-kicker eyebrow — the first text on the page, rendered in white at 13px/590 uppercase at x=20,y=80 — still reads the literal placeholder "YOUR NAME", so a CV hero never names its subject; replace that string (and the matching mailto:you@example.com on .hero-cta) with the real name and address.

violations.rule: 1.1 one idea per viewport / content integrity — the section's identity slot is unfilled
violations.measured: DOM: Your Name·Tel Aviv, Israel, rendered uppercase in rgb(247,248,248) at 13px/590, x=20 y=80 w=353 h=16 — the first text node in the section reads "YOUR NAME". The CTA is href="mailto:you@example.com" and the bottom-bar FAB is aria-label="Email Your Name".

violations.rule: 1.4 a single spacing scale, visibly obeyed
violations.measured: .hero-lede bottom = y 501; a.hero-cta top = y 608 -> a 107px void, produced by margin-top:67.0156px on .hero-actions plus padding-top:40px on the same element. Every other internal gap in the section is 20px (eyebrow 96 -> display 116) or 24px (display 319 -> lede 343), and the section's own padding is 80px top/bottom. The largest gap in the hero is therefore inside it, not around it, and 67.0156px is on no scale.
violations.where: div.hero-actions (margin-top 67.0156px + padding-top 40px), between p.hero-lede and a.hero-cta

violations.rule: 1.1 one idea per viewport — the hero does not own the first screen
violations.measured: #hero boundingBox height = 736px in an 852px viewport, so 116px of #proof (y=736) is visible at scroll 0. What shows is #proof's orphaned eyebrow "TRACK RECORD" alone — glyph row sampled at device y 2215 averages rgb(60,63,68) against the rgb(8,9,10) page — with its content cut off by the floating nav whose pill starts at y=771. The first screenshot therefore contains a hero, a second section's caption with no section under it, and a 5-item nav.
violations.where: section#hero height 736 vs viewport 852; #proof eyebrow at CSS y~738

violations.rule: 2.1 one accent, used sparingly / 1.1 one idea per viewport
violations.measured: Two accent-filled email controls are on screen simultaneously: a.hero-cta fill sampled at rgb(124,140,255) (CSS box x=20 y=608 132x48) and the bottom-bar FAB, aria-label "Email Your Name", fill sampled at rgb(115,130,236) (CSS box x=317 y=784 48x48) — the same hue, the same action, 128px apart vertically. Inside #hero itself the accent is used exactly once, which passes; composed, the first viewport shows it twice for one job.
violations.where: a.hero-cta y=608 and the nav FAB y=784

violations.rule: 1.2 body measure 32-40 characters at this width
violations.measured: .hero-lede is 353px wide at 17px and renders 6 line boxes of 38 / 36 / 44 / 36 / 35 / 40 characters (229 chars total, mean 38.2). Line 3 ("interfaces that ship, scale, and stay fast.") is 44 characters, above the 40-character ceiling, and visibly runs to the right gutter.

violations.rule: 2.1 body text contrast >= 4.5:1 against the actual surface
violations.measured: .hero-sep · is rgb(98,103,111) on rgb(8,9,10) = 3.50:1, below 4.5:1 at 13px (non-large). For comparison .hero-lede rgb(144,150,161) = 6.70:1 (passes), primary rgb(247,248,248) = 18.73:1 (passes), CTA label rgb(10,11,20) on rgb(124,140,255) = 6.59:1 (passes).

violations.rule: 2.4 restraint — gradients only as one large, very low-contrast atmospheric wash
violations.measured: The top band carries two separate lights, not one. Sampling 40x40 device-px blocks at y=40: x=0 rgb(18,20,30) (blue, B-R = +12), x=600 rgb(12,13,17) (trough), x=1000 rgb(20,21,22) (neutral, B-R = +2). The left wash peaks at device y=400 with rgb(24,27,43), a 4.29x relative-luminance lift over the rgb(8,9,10) page, and is fully gone by device y=1000 (CSS y 333) — i.e. it dies halfway through the headline. Strength is fine; the two-source, asymmetric falloff is not.
violations.where: top 333 CSS px of #hero; computed backgroundImage on #hero is 'none', so the wash comes from an ancestor layer

evidence: Started the site myself (harness/serve.mjs on :4173) and ran harness/shot.mjs hero. Opened with the Read tool and looked at: /home/user/cartridge/cv-site/captures/critic-r1/hero/hero-viewport-000.png, hero-element.png, hero-motion-000.png, hero-motion-002.png. Hashed all six motion frames (identical md5). Then re-instrumented the running page with Playwright on the same profile (393x852, DPR 3, 4x CPU throttle) for computed styles, box geometry, a 26-sample entrance trace from navigation commit, a prefers-reduced-motion pass, per-character line-box counts for the lede, and canvas pixel sampling of hero-viewport-000.png. Phantom check per the calibration note: the top-right region of the hero measures max luminance 26 over a 160x160 device-px block and document.elementFromPoint(360,30) returns the bare <section id="hero">, so there is no envelope icon there and I have not reported one. Passes I confirmed and am not counting against it: display 47.946px / weight 680 / letter-spacing -1.82195px (-0.0380em) / line-height 50.8228px (1.060) all in band; type jumps 47.9->17 = 2.82x and 17->13 = 1.31x, both >= 1.25x; lede 17px / 400 / line-height 26.35px (1.55); eyebrow 13px / 590 / 1.105px (0.085em) uppercase, once per section; CTA 132x48 with 10px radius and no visible stroke; CTA at CSS y 608-656 = 71-77% down the viewport, inside the lower 40%; document.scrollWidth 393 (no overflow); viewport meta 'width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover' with no maximum-scale; nav tap boxes 62x48 at 8px spacing.
